## Accepted basis

The SCI-NOI r0.4 architecture is accepted without re-derivation. GEN, UNC, and
STD remain separate; the ordinary observation/array route, exact rational
balance design, bounded rejection, with-replacement member law, fixed member
operator/response, source-bearing claim, zero-centered all-member second
moment, no reciprocal, independently governed MAP numerator, STD claim and
response boundary, immutable parents, stable identifiers, and claim ceilings
remain in force.

## Required final closures

1. Protect the unconditioned assignment target from assignment- or output-
   dependent member selection. Binding completion and use predicates are fixed
   before assignment or proven invariant. Advisory diagnostics cannot change
   membership. Assignment-dependent failure makes the method unavailable. A
   required assignment-dependent gate defines a different conditioned method.
2. Distinguish the scientific randomization measure, the ideal key/bit-
   selection law, and deterministic replay. Use disposition B: iid uniformity
   is the declared ideal randomization model; generator/randomness adequacy is
   a separately named validation layer. Replay establishes identity, not
   statistical independence or generator validation.
3. Type the UNC set/count equality as a consequence of realized initial UNC.
   In unavailable or failed states, actual unequal counts and causes remain
   factual and no estimator or changed divisor exists.
4. Bind the design rational to a lossless canonical encoding of the exact
   frozen MAP contribution, including parent/product generations, coefficient
   family/payload, representation source, and digest. The rational governs NOI
   design only and never replaces MAP arithmetic. Missing lossless encoding
   makes design resolution unavailable.
5. Keep `not_requested` and `explicitly_disabled` distinct. Both have zero
   requested cardinality and no downstream product; only the disabled state
   retains an exact request/effective-plan identity plus disabling owner,
   policy, and cause.
6. Revise all affected profiles, source closure, route wording, traceability,
   parity reports, PDFs, and one superseding freeze manifest that binds the
   complete authority graph and generated views.

## Freeze disposition and ceiling

The implementation-independent scientific contract may be proposed for
conditional freeze while exact numerical parents/routes, revised profile
approval and Registry binding, complete STD response, implementation
conformity, and empirical validation remain unavailable or unassessed. Those
states block dependent products and claims; they do not prevent coherent
scientific-contract freeze.

No implementation conformity, random-generator validation, calibration,
physical-noise validity, covariance completeness, Gaussian significance,
achieved performance, readiness, production suitability, or production
authorization is granted.
